goal: A 2D browser spelling game indistinguishable from a shipped studio title

modules.title: Engine core (WebGL2 batcher, atlas, loop, input, audio, save)
Hedgehog character art + animation set
modules.verdict: Face no longer tumbles (quill wheel spins, body held forward-facing, <=12deg tilt); silhouette separation -23..+0 -> +43..+79 across idle/dash/jump/celebration via shade rings + pose aura + warm rim + value floor; contact shadow now 41 luma under him vs clear ground; takeoff crouch, launch stretch and a held landing beat with hitstop/shake/ground ring; JUMP control clamped clear of the hero at 7 viewports.

modules.title: Letter tiles, smash states, typography
modules.verdict: Painted block sprites with a pooled-recess + hard-outline glyph stack, spring physics, column jolt and a chunky material-coloured smash; 3 draw calls / 75 sprites for the field.

modules.title: World art: parallax layers, tilesets, props
modules.verdict: Dusk palette restored: sky resampled to carry the full indigo-violet-magenta-coral-amber ramp (SKY_V0 0.66->0.34, tint 1.76/1.82/1.46 -> 1.60/1.32/1.46, v=1 landed at y=474 so the amber shows above the hills instead of behind them); highlights re-bought locally from a tight horizon glow, a near-opaque sun-rake on the soil top, sun-struck fringe grass and a 17-piece lit cloud bank that shares the atlas bind; far layers de-milked with mauve/blue-teal hue tints instead of neutral lifts; fixed a 1.4 tint clamp in buildRow that had been silently discarding every sun-struck row tint. World-only desktop median 107-124, p95 190-216, 14-21% below 25%; 17 draw calls (one fewer than before), 0 console errors.

modules.title: FX: particles, trails, impact and screen shake
UI kit: HUD, menus, transitions
modules.verdict: HUD rebuilt on screen anchors (safeTop/viewLeft/viewRight/viewBottom): one top row, one message channel with severity priority, combo docked under the strip, word bar demoted to a floating plaque that uncovers the painted bank, plus a one-button HINT that recalls the clue mid-word without blocking taps.

modules.title: Core loop: spawn, aim, dash, smash, scoring
modules.verdict: Jump/dodge shipped (Space, sky-tap, on-screen JUMP button, swipe-up) plus four fairness fixes: dash no longer retires walls it flies over, setback pushback re-arms walls, block taps resolve by nearest centre, hero rim restores silhouette. winnable 10/10, 0 deadlocks, 0 console errors.

modules.title: Progression: levels, difficulty curve, unlocks
modules.verdict: Rank curve + 10 milestones + spark/milestone dual-path unlocks; rounded Workshop scene with live hedgehog preview, touch/mouse/keyboard parity, persistence verified across reload.

modules.title: Word lists, phonics tiers, distractor generation
Audio: TTS pronunciation, SFX, music beds
modules.verdict: Layered procedural SFX (transient+crack+body+tail smash with per-hit jitter, soft non-punishing bounce/setback, arpeggiated wordComplete), adaptive music bed with setIntensity/duck, speech watchdog + Chrome resume fix, limiter + soft-clip ceiling; offline-verified peaks 0.06-0.44, no clipping/NaN/node leaks, tsc clean.
